title: 第十九章 暗影突袭绝境逼迫第二十章 时雷天启苍瞬觉醒
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 初秋的日光褪去了盛夏的燥热，温柔细碎地铺满整座琉光星冕综合学园。
整洁宽敞的学园道路两侧，葱郁的香樟树枝繁叶茂，层层叠叠的绿意隔绝了外界所有喧嚣，微风穿叶而过，拂起簌簌轻响，裹挟着草木独有的清新气息，漫遍校园每一处角落。
课间的校园永远鲜活热闹。
穿着统一蓝白校服的学生们三三两两结伴而行，嬉笑打闹的清脆声响、低声讨论课业的轻柔语调、走廊间来回穿梭的轻快脚步声，交织成最纯粹美好的校园日常。阳光透过枝叶缝隙洒落，在地面投下斑驳错落的光影，温柔又安稳，勾勒出独属于青春的澄澈与温柔。
历经昨日广场的明暗对峙与恩怨清算，整座学园重归平和静谧，无人知晓暗流已然涌动，一场针对性的致命危机，正跨越虚空，朝着这座安宁的学园悄然逼近。
教学楼顶层的露天天台，是整座学园最僻静、最开阔的独处之地。
这里远离教学楼的喧闹人声，隔绝了走廊的嬉笑嘈杂，常年只有清风与天光相伴，素来是不喜热闹、偏爱安静的学生独处散心的绝佳去处。
御神苍瞬独自伫立在天台的围栏边缘。
一身规整利落的琉光星冕学园蓝白校服衬得她身姿愈发挺拔清瘦，霆冰蓝渐变的长直发顺着微凉的晨风自然垂落，柔顺的发丝垂至腰际，发尾藏着不易察觉的细碎雷光微光，在通透日光下若隐若现，清冷又独特。
她脊背挺直，身姿孤高，微微抬眸望向远方澄澈无垠的天际，冰空寒宇色的眼眸平静无波，眼底却深深藏着无人窥见的沉重与挣扎。
自昨日傍晚，在城郊高空亲眼目睹五位守护者的全员战斗、亲身触发血脉深处的本源共鸣、又以极致意志力暴力镇压时雷双生力量之后，她的心神便始终未能真正平复。
强行封禁本源带来的经脉钝痛依旧隐隐萦绕肌理，丝丝缕缕的酸涩痛感顺着四肢百骸缓缓蔓延，时刻提醒着她昨日那场惊心动魄的力量躁动与自我压制。
更让她心绪难平的，是藤咲若织一行五人昨日温柔包容、绝不逼迫的模样。
她孤身漂泊人间三年，隐姓埋名、封闭本心，早已习惯了世间的冷漠疏离、试探戒备，早已认定人心皆凉、世事皆苦，所有的温柔皆是假象，所有的羁绊终会消散，所有的力量终将招致毁灭。
可那五位宿命同源的同伴，在窥见她暗藏的力量、看穿她刻意的疏离、察觉她深藏的伤痛之后，没有半分窥探的恶意，没有半分逼迫的施压，只是安静尊重她的沉默，温柔包容她的孤僻，真诚许下守护秘密的约定。
这份毫无缘由、不求回报的善意，是她覆灭家园、孤身流浪三年以来，第一次触碰的温暖。
陌生、滚烫，却又让人忍不住贪恋。
指尖微微收紧，校服袖口下的纤细指节泛出浅浅的青白，御神苍瞬敛下眼眸，长长的睫羽轻轻颤动，遮住了眼底翻涌的复杂心绪。
心底深处，两种截然不同的念头正在反复拉扯、无尽博弈。
一边是根深蒂固、刻入骨髓的恐惧执念。
冰川神域覆灭的血色画面、至亲族人陨落的绝望场景、漫天黑暗吞噬故土的惨烈过往，日复一日在她脑海中循环回放，死死烙印在神魂深处。
力量越强，失去越多。
越是守护，越是荒芜。
这是她用满门鲜血、一城废墟换来的真理，是支撑她封闭自我、压制力量、孤身存活至今的唯一执念。她不敢解锁力量，不敢接纳宿命，更不敢贪恋任何人的温暖与羁绊，她怕自己与生俱来的顶级时雷力量，终会连累身边所有温柔待她之人，让眼前这份难得的安稳与温暖，尽数化为泡影。
而另一边，是昨日那场光明对决带给她的极致触动，是五位守护者并肩相守、生死与共的滚烫羁绊。
她亲眼看见，五人各司其职、默契相融，以纯粹的守护之心抗衡黑暗、守护学园、守护素不相识的众生。她们拥有强大的力量，却从未被力量反噬；她们背负沉重的宿命，却从未被宿命压垮；她们深知黑暗的险恶，却依旧心怀赤诚、向阳而生。
原来力量从不是灾祸的根源，人心与执念，才是左右宿命的最终答案。
原来手握力量，不必只剩毁灭与失去，亦可守护、亦可相守、亦可奔赴温柔与光明。
两种念想日夜交织、反复撕扯，让本就心绪紧绷、心魔缠身的御神苍瞬，愈发心神不宁、进退两难。
她既渴望挣脱多年的枷锁，接纳属于自己的宿命与力量，融入这份滚烫真挚的同伴羁绊；又畏惧过往的阴影重演，畏惧自己终将亲手摧毁眼前所有的美好与温柔。
长久的自我封闭与内心煎熬，让她周身的清冷气场愈发浓重，生人勿近的疏离感层层笼罩，将她与整片热闹鲜活的校园彻底隔绝，自成一片孤寂寒凉的天地。
天台寂静无声，唯有清风拂过发丝的轻响，时光仿佛在此刻静止，只剩少女孤身伫立，独自承受无人共情的挣扎与煎熬。
与此同时，无人窥见的虚空深渊，暗影结界最深处。
暗沉死寂、黑雾翻涌的幽暗疆域里，没有天光、没有风声、没有生机，唯有无尽寒凉的黑暗与蚀骨的戾气终年盘踞。
整片虚空被浓稠如墨的暗黑能量彻底笼罩，翻涌的黑雾扭曲浮动，不断侵蚀、湮灭周遭所有微弱的气息，死寂、压抑、荒芜，是这片暗影疆域永恒不变的基调。
幽暗高台之上，一道身姿妖娆、气场森寒的玄黑身影静静端坐。
层层叠叠的暗樱纹路黑袍覆满周身，繁复诡谲的暗黑符文在衣料表层缓缓流转、明暗闪烁，周身萦绕着足以碾压万物的顶级暗黑威压，每一寸空气都因她的存在而剧烈凝滞、冰冷刺骨。
她便是统领整片暗影深渊、掌控所有暗黑势力的至高主宰，暗樱女王。
苍白近乎透明的指尖轻轻搭在王座扶手上，纤细的指腹缓缓摩挲着冰凉的黑曜石纹路，狭长的凤眸覆满终年不散的幽暗与冷戾，眼底深处藏着睥睨众生、掌控棋局的极致狂妄与阴狠。
自百年前与光明守护者阵营对立博弈以来，她便始终布局暗处，步步蚕食世间光明力量，伺机颠覆人间安稳，一统六域宿命棋局。
多年来，她逐一探查、逐一锁定散落人间的天命守护者，暗中清除、策反、打压，一点点瓦解光明阵营的核心战力，只为等待时机成熟，一举踏平人间，颠覆宿命秩序。
此前，她早已精准锁定天野凛星、藤咲若织、海月涟音、琉璃金朵、夜见幽弥五位守护者的身份与踪迹，对五人的力量属性、战斗方式、羁绊关系尽数了然于心，也早已布下层层暗棋，伺机逐步瓦解、逐个击破。
content_en:
The early autumn sunlight has faded away from the heat of midsummer, and spreads over the entire Ryukwang Star Crown Comprehensive Academy with gentleness.
On both sides of the clean and spacious campus road, lush camphor branches are lush and leafy. The layers of green isolate all the noise of the outside world. The breeze passes through the leaves, making a soft rustling sound, carrying the unique fresh smell of the vegetation, permeating every corner of the campus.
The campus is always lively and lively during breaks.
Students wearing uniforms of blue and white school uniforms walked together in twos and threes. The crisp sounds of laughter and laughter, the soft tones of low-pitched discussions about homework, and the brisk footsteps walking back and forth in the corridors intertwined into the purest and most beautiful campus daily life. The sun shines through the gaps between the branches and leaves, casting mottled light and shadow on the ground. It is gentle and stable, outlining the clarity and tenderness unique to youth.
After the confrontation between light and dark in the square yesterday and the settlement of grievances, the entire school returned to peace and quiet. No one knew that the undercurrent was already surging, and a targeted fatal crisis was crossing the void and quietly approaching this peaceful school.
The open-air rooftop on the top floor of the teaching building is the most secluded and spacious place for solitude in the entire academy.
This place is far away from the noisy people in the teaching building and isolated from the laughter and noise in the corridor. It is only accompanied by the breeze and the sky all year round. It has always been an excellent place for students who do not like bustling and prefer quiet to relax alone.
Royal God Cang Shun stood alone on the edge of the fence on the rooftop.
She was dressed neatly in the blue and white school uniform of Liuguang Xingmian Academy, which made her figure even taller and slimmer. Her long straight hair with a gradient of icy blue naturally fell down in the cool morning breeze. The soft hair fell to her waist. There was an unnoticeable shimmer of lightning at the end of her hair, which was looming under the clear sunlight, making it cold and unique.
Her back was straight, her posture was aloof, and she slightly raised her eyes to look at the boundless clear sky in the distance. Her ice-colored eyes were calm and calm, but deep inside her eyes lay the heaviness and struggle that no one could see.
Ever since yesterday evening, when she witnessed the battle of all five guardians at high altitude on the outskirts of the city, personally triggered the original resonance deep in her bloodline, and violently suppressed the power of the Time and Thunder Twins with her ultimate willpower, her mind has never been able to truly calm down.
The dull pain in her meridians caused by the forcible sealing of the source still lingered faintly in her texture, and the strands of soreness and pain slowly spread along her limbs and bones, always reminding her of yesterday's thrilling power agitation and self-repression.
What made her even more upset was the gentle and tolerant way Fujisaki Wakaori and the five of them behaved yesterday, without forcing anything.
She has been wandering alone in the world for three years, hiding her name and closing her heart. She has long been accustomed to the world's indifference, alienation, temptation and wariness. She has long since concluded that people's hearts are cold and everything in the world is bitter. All tenderness is an illusion, all bonds will eventually dissipate, and all power will eventually lead to destruction.
But those five companions with the same fate, after seeing her hidden strength, seeing through her deliberate alienation, and noticing her deep pain, did not have the slightest malice of prying, nor any pressure from coercion. They just quietly respected her silence, gently tolerated her isolation, and sincerely made a promise to protect the secret.
This kind of kindness without any reason and without asking for anything in return was the first warmth she encountered since her home was destroyed and she wandered alone for three years.
Strange and hot, yet people can't help but crave it.
The fingertips tightened slightly, and the slender knuckles under the cuffs of the school uniform showed a light blue-white color. Yu Shencang immediately lowered his eyes, and his long eyelashes trembled slightly, covering the complicated emotions surging in his eyes.
Deep in my heart, two completely different thoughts are repeatedly pulling and playing endless games.
On one side is the fear and obsession that is deep-rooted and engraved in the bone marrow.
The bloody scenes of the destruction of the Glacier God Realm, the desperate scenes of the deaths of close relatives, and the tragic past of the darkness swallowing up the homeland were replayed in her mind day after day, imprinted in the depths of her soul.
The more powerful you are, the more you lose.
The more guarded it is, the more desolate it becomes.
This is the truth she gained in exchange for a whole family of blood and a city in ruins. It is the only obsession that supports her to close herself, suppress her power, and survive alone until now. She didn't dare to unlock her power, didn't dare to accept her fate, and she didn't dare to covet anyone's warmth and bond. She was afraid that her innate top-level power of time and thunder would eventually affect all the people around her who were gentle to her, and the rare stability and warmth in front of her would be wiped out.
On the other side, she was deeply touched by yesterday's bright duel, and the fiery bond of the five guardians standing side by side, sharing life and death.
She saw with her own eyes that the five of them each performed their own duties and worked in harmony with each other. They fought against the darkness, guarded the school, and protected sentient beings they had never met with their pure protective hearts. They have great power, but they have never been bitten by it; they bear a heavy fate, but they have never been crushed by it; they are well aware of the dangers of darkness, but they are still sincere and live towards the sun.
It turns out that power is never the source of disaster. Human heart and obsession are the final answers to destiny.
It turns out that with power, you don’t have to be left with only destruction and loss. You can also protect, stay with, and run toward tenderness and light.
The two thoughts were intertwined day and night, and were repeatedly torn apart, making Yu Shen Cang Shun, who was already tense and haunted by inner demons, increasingly uneasy and in a dilemma.
She is eager to break free from the shackles of many years, accept her own destiny and strength, and integrate into this hot and sincere companionship; but she is also afraid that the shadow of the past will reappear, and she is afraid that she will eventually destroy all the beauty and tenderness in front of her with her own hands.
The long-term self-isolation and inner suffering made the cold aura around her become stronger and stronger, and the sense of alienation from strangers shrouded her, completely cutting her off from the lively and lively campus, creating a lonely and cold world of her own.
The rooftop was silent, except for the soft sound of the breeze blowing through her hair. Time seemed to have stopped at this moment, leaving the girl alone, enduring the struggle and suffering that no one could empathize with.
At the same time, there is the abyss of void that no one can see, the deepest part of the Shadow Barrier.
In the dark realm of darkness, deathly silence, and billowing black mist, there is no skylight, no sound of wind, and no life. Only the endless cold darkness and the bone-eroding hostility linger all year round.
The entire void was completely shrouded in dark energy as thick as ink. The surging black mist twisted and floated, constantly eroding and annihilating all the weak breaths around it. Dead silence, depression, and desolation were the eternal tone of this shadow territory.
On the dark high platform, a black figure with enchanting appearance and cold aura sat quietly.
Layers of black robes with dark cherry patterns covered her whole body. Complex and strange dark runes slowly flowed on the surface of the clothing, flickering in light and dark. She was surrounded by top-notch dark pressure that could crush all things. Every inch of the air was violently stagnant and icy cold due to her presence.
She is the supreme master who rules the entire Shadow Abyss and controls all dark forces, the Queen of Dark Sakura.
His pale and almost transparent fingertips rested lightly on the armrest of the throne, and his slender fingertips slowly rubbed the cold obsidian lines. His narrow phoenix eyes were filled with darkness and coldness that persisted all year round. Deep in his eyes was the ultimate arrogance and cruelty of looking down on all living beings and controlling the chess game.
Ever since her confrontation with the Light Guardian camp a hundred years ago, she has been strategizing in the darkness, eroding the power of light in the world step by step, waiting for opportunities to subvert the stability of the world, and unify the fateful chess game of the six realms.
Over the years, she has explored and targeted the guardians of destiny scattered in the world one by one, secretly eliminated, instigated rebellion, and suppressed them, gradually disintegrating the core combat power of the light camp, just waiting for the time to mature, leveling the world in one fell swoop, and overturning the order of destiny.
Previously, she had already pinpointed the identities and traces of the five guardians, Amano Rinsei, Fujisaki Wakaori, Umizuki Renone, Ruri Jinduo, and Yami Yuya. She knew all about their power attributes, fighting methods, and bonding relationships. She had also laid out layers of secret chess, waiting for opportunities to gradually disintegrate and defeat them one by one.
title_en: Chapter 19: Shadow Raid, Desperate Situation, Chapter 20: Shi Lei Tianqi Cang Shun Awakens
